theater: 多瑙河下游與高盧北境

battle.name: 匈人入侵歐洲
battle.theater: 多瑙河下游與高盧北境
battle.brief: 公元434年，匈人聯盟越過喀爾巴阡山，席捲羅馬行省潘諾尼亞並圍攻西米里烏姆，451年大軍西征、452年回師劫掠米蘭與阿奎萊亞。卡面的羅馬方陣盾代表羅馬防禦步兵的核心：凸面盾與盾牆頂住匈人複合弓的齊射，但五世紀時方盾已讓位於橢圓盾與日耳曼盟軍的圓盾。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 交戰方分成匈人聯盟與羅馬帝國兩大陣營，中間還夾雜大量被捲入的日耳曼與阿蘭部眾。匈人一方是駐牧於潘諾尼亞與多瑙河上游之間的遊牧聯盟，魯吉拉與其弟巴拉米爾（後世稱阿提拉）於434年越過喀爾巴阡山，席捲羅馬行省潘諾尼亞，再沿河向西北掃入諾里庫姆與高盧；聯盟旗下裹挾東哥特、格皮德、阿蘭等部落的騎兵，以及被征服後編為徒附的雜兵。西羅馬由瓦倫提尼安三世坐鎮拉韋納，邊防靠帝國野戰軍與邊防常備軍，統制大權集中於執政官弗拉維烏斯·艾提烏斯手中，關鍵守將包括禁衛統帥普里斯庫斯與多瑙河沿岸的總督。羅馬一方真正的野戰主力其實是外族盟軍：西哥特王狄奧多里克一世率部於451年參戰，另有勃艮第人、法蘭克人、阿蘭人、薩克遜人與不列顛盟軍。東羅馬由狄奧多西二世與權臣克里薩菲烏斯主持君士坦丁堡，自447年起同時面對匈人勒索，卻從不向西線派一兵一卒。三方之間並無互信，東西羅馬各求自保，匈人正因如此得以逐段得手。
countriesEn: The belligerents fall into two great camps, the Hunnic confederation and the Roman Empire, with a great many Germanic and Alan peoples dragged into the fighting in between. On the Hunnic side stood a nomadic confederation pasturing between Pannonia and the upper Danube; Rugila and his brother Balamir, later called Attila, crossed the Carpathians in 434, swept the Roman province of Pannonia, and then drove northwest along the river into Noricum and Gaul. Their columns carried the mounted warriors of the Goths, Gepids and Alans, together with a mass of auxiliaries drawn from conquered peoples. The Western Roman Empire was ruled from Ravenna by Valentinian III, its frontier resting on the imperial field army and the limitanei, with real power concentrated in the hands of the magister militum Flavius Aetius and key field commanders such as Priscus and the Danubian governors. Rome's real strength in the field lay with its federate allies: the Visigothic king Theodoric I brought his people to the battle in 451, and Burgundians, Franks, Alans, Saxons and British contingents fought alongside. The Eastern Empire, under Theodosius II and the eunuch Chrysaphius at Constantinople, became a second object of Hunnic extortion from 447 onward, yet it never sent a single soldier to the western front. None of the three parties trusted the others, East and West each looked only to their own survival, and precisely because of that the Huns were able to gain ground step by step.
people: 關鍵人物分屬三個圈子。匈人一側，魯吉拉是434年越過喀爾巴阡山、拍板向西擴張的統帥，據朱達尼斯記載他在435年前後病死，弟弟巴拉米爾接手並被後世稱為阿提拉；阿提拉在440年代整合北匈奴、南匈奴與各附庸部眾，448年向東羅馬索取巨額黃金，451年在卡塔拉尼恩平原親率大軍西征，452年回師劫掠義大利，453年死後其帝國隨即在454年那達奧河之戰中被格皮德王阿爾達里克擊潰。羅馬一側，執政官弗拉維烏斯·艾提烏斯是全場戰役的樞紐：他在434年解西米里烏姆之圍，442年以外交手段把勃艮第人遷往索恩河，又以歲幣換取邊境安寧；瓦倫提尼安三世是西羅馬皇帝，443年下令增建君士坦丁堡城牆，正是恐懼的直接產物；禁衛將領普里斯庫斯屢次解圍，君士坦丁堡的權臣克里薩菲烏斯則以二千磅黃金買下448年的危機。盟軍方面，西哥特王狄奧多里克一世在卡塔拉尼恩之戰中陣亡，其死直接引發聯軍的退卻。史料主要出自朱達尼斯《哥特史》與西多尼烏斯·阿波利納里斯的記述，其中夸張的成分需要打折對待。
peopleEn: The decisive figures come from three circles. On the Hunnic side, Rugila was the commander who crossed the Carpathians in 434 and chose to push west; according to Jordanes he died of illness around 435, and his brother Balamir, known to later history as Attila, took over. Attila welded the northern and southern Huns together with a dozen dependent peoples during the 440s, extracted a huge sum in gold from the Eastern Empire in 448, led the great western host onto the Catalaunian Plains in 451, and turned back to ravage Italy in 452; after his death in 453 his empire was shattered at the River Nedao in 454 by Ardaric, king of the Gepids. On the Roman side the hinge was the magister militum Flavius Aetius, who relieved the siege of Sirmium in 434, engineered the transfer of the Burgundians to the Saône in 442 by diplomacy, and bought frontier peace with annual tribute. Valentinian III, the Western emperor, ordered the extension of the Constantinian city walls in 443, a direct product of fear; the guard commander Priscus repeatedly relieved threatened cities, and Chrysaphius, the powerful eunuch at Constantinople, settled the crisis of 448 with two thousand pounds of gold. Among the allies, Theodoric I of the Visigoths was killed at the Catalaunian battle, and his death directly triggered the allied withdrawal. The main sources are Jordanes in the Getica and Sidonius Apollinaris, and their rhetorical exaggeration has to be discounted.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾（scutum），是羅馬共和與帝國早期步兵的標誌裝備：凸面長方形，寬約六十至一百二十公分、高約九十公分，邊框以木與皮革鑲嵌，中脊與中央盾紐用來偏開來箭，握把與腕帶讓長矛兵受力時仍能穩住盾。必須說清楚的是：到434年，羅馬公民步兵早已解散，方盾在常備軍中逐漸讓位於橢圓大盾，而聯軍中的日耳曼盟軍多持圓盾；方盾的形制在五世紀並非主流。然而它所代表的戰術原理仍站在戰場中央——以凸面與盾紐卸開複合弓的重箭、以盾緣互咬形成連續盾牆、用人牆頂住馬蹄衝擊，這正是羅馬對付匈人騎射唯一可靠的答案。匈人一方是清一色的騎兵弓手：反曲的角製複合弓，弓弦拉緊，有效射程可達二百至三百米；頭戴鑲鐵或鑲銅的頭盔，身穿皮革或毛皮鎧甲，配雙刃直刀與短柄馬刀、榆木杆鐵矛頭的長矛，以及從馬上拋擲的套索標槍。戰馬是匈人真正的裝備，每名戰士常備二至三匹，用來維持連續衝鋒與追擊。攻城時他們用雲梯、撞柱與挖地道，也以弓陣壓制守軍、封鎖城郊糧道，逼迫守軍耗盡體力。羅馬方面除盾牌外，還有鎖子甲、鱗甲、條紋罩袍、羅馬標槍（pilum）、短劍、鷹式標準與帳篷，並保有當時最完整的攻城技術：雲梯、撞錘、投石機與弩砲。羅馬的真正優勢在城牆、在道路、在地中海糧道，而不在野戰。
kitsEn: The card's Roman scutum was the signature piece of Roman infantry in the Republic and the early Empire: a convex rectangle roughly sixty to one hundred and twenty centimetres wide and about ninety high, framed in wood and leather, with a central spine and boss used to deflect incoming arrows, and with a grip and wrist-strap that let a spearman hold the shield steady under impact. It must be said plainly that by 434 the citizen infantry had long since been disbanded, the rectangular shield had been giving way to the large oval shield in the regular army, and the Germanic federates in the allied ranks mostly carried round shields; the scutum's shape was no longer mainstream in the fifth century. What did remain in the middle of the battlefield was the tactical principle it embodied: using the curve and the boss to turn aside the heavy arrows of a composite bow, locking shield edge to shield edge to form a continuous wall, and standing that wall up against the impact of hooves, which was the only dependable answer Rome had to Hunnic mounted archery. The Hunnic side was uniformly mounted archers: reflex composite bows of horn and sinew, strung hard, with an effective range of two hundred to three hundred metres; iron- or bronze-banded helmets; leather or fur armour; double-edged straight swords and short sabres; spears with elm shafts and iron heads; and lances with looped cords thrown from horseback. Horses were the real equipment of the Huns, with two or three mounts kept per warrior so that a second and third charge could be mounted without pause. For siege work they used ladders, rams and covered tunnels, and they used the bow to suppress the defenders while they sealed the food roads outside the walls and wore the garrison down. On the Roman side, beyond the shields, the army had mail and scale armour, striped tunics, the pilum, the short sword, the eagle standard and the tent, and it still commanded the most complete siege technology of the age: ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers and ballistae. Rome's real strength lay in walls, in roads and in the Mediterranean grain supply, not in the open field.
tactics: 匈人的戰法核心是馬上機動加箭雨壓制，而非要塞正面硬撞。進入歐洲前線後，聯盟避免強攻羅馬城牆，而以大縱深騎兵沿多瑙河、萊茵河上游快速掃掠，逼迫羅馬把野戰軍從城內拉出來；作戰時以數千至一萬多騎的寬正面同時展開射擊，箭幕覆蓋數百米，然後靠縱深預備隊在局部形成密集接觸，於平原上把人海戰術用在羅馬縱隊的側後。羅馬一方的應對是先守城、後決戰：西米里烏姆、諾里庫姆、斯特拉斯堡等地都靠城牆與援軍抵達的時間差拖住匈人，羅馬寧可付黃金買時間，也不願在開闊地與之騎射對射。451年卡塔拉尼恩平原的會戰則是聯軍刻意在高盧北部平原截住匈人：中央以羅馬禁衛軍與皇族部隊正面對峙，左翼交給西哥特與法蘭克，右翼為阿蘭與勃艮第騎兵，目的是用聯軍的寬正面吸收匈軍衝擊，再在對方騎兵掠過陣線、縱深暴露時以羅馬騎兵反擊包抄。守城講究封閉城門、切斷城外水源與糧道、在城頭以連續射擊消耗進攻者的體力；攻城則在城外扎營，分批驅使徒附填壕、架雲梯、造繩梯與活動塔。這種圍而不急攻、以耗養敵的做法，正是匈人兩度兵臨君士坦丁堡卻最終退走、而義大利諸城仍被攻破的技術原因。
tacticsEn: The core of Hunnic method was mounted mobility backed by massed arrow fire, not frontal assault against fortifications. Once on the European frontier, the confederation avoided storming Roman walls and instead swept forward with a deep body of horsemen along the Danube and the upper Rhine, forcing Rome to drag its field army out of its cities. In action they opened fire with several thousand to more than ten thousand riders deployed across a wide front, blanketing several hundred metres with a curtain of arrows, and then used reserves to form dense local contact on the plain, applying mass tactics to the flanks and rear of the Roman columns. Rome's answer was to defend first and to decide the battle later: Sirmium, Noricum and Argentoratum were all held with walls and with the time gained by the arrival of relief armies, and Rome preferred to buy time with gold rather than trade volleys of arrows on open ground. The battle of the Catalaunian Plains in 451 was a deliberate interception on the northern plains of Gaul: the Roman guard and imperial troops held the centre, the Visigoths and Franks were given the left wing, and the Alan and Burgundian cavalry the right, the intention being to absorb the Hunnic charge with the width of the allied line and then counterattack with Roman cavalry once the Hunnic horse had ridden past the line and exposed its flanks. Defenders closed the gates, cut the water and food roads outside the walls, and wore the attackers down with continuous shooting from the ramparts. Besiegers camped outside, filled the ditches in relays with captive followers, and raised ladders, rope ladders and movable towers. This method of besieging without pressing the attack, of wearing the enemy down instead, explains both why the Huns twice withdrew from before Constantinople and why the Italian cities nevertheless fell.
data: 關於兵數與損耗，可靠的具體數字不多，餘下的都要打折看。435年羅馬為換取邊境安寧向匈人交付的歲幣，一般記為每年三百五十磅黃金；448年東羅馬在克里薩菲烏斯主導下再付二千磅黃金，並約定按年續納，一年的軍費就此被吃掉。451年卡塔拉尼恩平原之戰，朱達尼斯記載羅馬與匈人雙方各死一萬五千至二萬人，這是同時代唯一具體的傷亡數，但更像修辭性的整數；聯軍一側常被估算為二萬上下，匈軍則有五萬至六萬之說，同一部作品所稱的三十萬兵員，多數學者認為是把全國可調集人口一併計入的誇大。距離方面，匈人自潘諾尼亞越過喀爾巴阡山至多瑙河，約三百公里；442年自萊茵河上游推進至奧爾良一線，約七百公里；451年由萊茵河谷地南下截擊至馬恩河一線，再折回來襲義大利，來回行程逾一千五百公里。羅馬方面，443年起在君士坦丁堡城牆外側另築三重防禦線，總長約五公里，447年匈人兵臨城下時尚未完全竣工，452年遷都後成為抵禦草原民族的主要防線。羅馬軍隊的實際規模此時難以核實：西部野戰軍常被估為數萬量級，其中核心羅馬步兵與日耳曼盟軍的比例常為一比一至一比二，這個結構本身說明羅馬早已無法單靠方盾兵團作戰。
dataEn: On numbers and losses, concrete figures are scarce and everything else has to be discounted. The tribute Rome paid the Huns in 435 to buy frontier peace is generally recorded as three hundred and fifty pounds of gold a year; in 448 the Eastern Empire, under Chrysaphius, paid another two thousand pounds of gold and agreed to continue the payment annually, which consumed a whole year's military budget in one stroke. For the battle of the Catalaunian Plains in 451 Jordanes records fifteen to twenty thousand dead on each side, the only specific casualty figure from the period, and it looks more like a rhetorical round number than a count. The allied side is usually estimated at around twenty thousand, the Hunnic host at fifty to sixty thousand, while the three hundred thousand men claimed in the same work are held by most scholars to be an exaggeration that swept the entire mobilisable population into a single column. As for distances: from Pannonia across the Carpathians to the Danube is some three hundred kilometres; the advance from the upper Rhine to the line of Orleans in 442 is about seven hundred; and the movement in 451, down the Rhine valley to intercept the Huns on the Marne and then back to Italy, came to more than fifteen hundred kilometres in all. On the Roman side, from 443 a triple line of fortifications was added outside the walls of Constantinople, roughly five kilometres in total; it was still unfinished when the Huns stood before the city in 447, and after the transfer of the capital it became the principal barrier against the peoples of the steppe. The true size of the Roman army is hard to establish at this point: the western field army is often put in the tens of thousands, and within it the ratio of native Roman infantry to Germanic federates commonly runs from one to one to one to two, a structure that itself shows Rome could no longer fight on its own shield infantry alone.
cause: 匈人西征並非由單一事件觸發，而是三股力量在同一條時間線上交疊的結果。源頭在東方：匈奴聯盟在四世紀崩解之後，其西部族群受柔然汗國壓迫，被迫西遷，經高加索、黑海北岸草原一路抵達多瑙河下游；此處早已聚居著日耳曼與阿蘭部落，三方混戰消耗了匈人的實力，也把他們推到羅馬邊境。羅馬方面，自395年帝國永久分裂為東西兩半，西部只剩稅基與常備軍的殘餘；375年以來大批西哥特人、汪達爾人進入帝國境內，先是376年渡多瑙河，382年又被提奧多西一世收編為盟軍，四世紀末的客居安排原本正是羅馬用來擋住草原民族的第一道緩衝，匈人一到，這道緩衝立刻失效。匈人本身的選擇是關鍵：他們看穿西羅馬在428年艾提烏斯失勢後的虛弱、多瑙河防線上城鎮空虛、羅馬東西兩半互不信任，於是先取最薄弱的邊境防線，取得立足點與糧食，再以馬匹帶來的機動優勢逐段深入西歐，而不是硬攻君士坦丁堡。447年轉向東方勒索，更說明匈人清楚羅馬的付款能力遠大於作戰能力，於是外交與勒索比戰爭更划算。
causeEn: The western drive of the Huns was not triggered by a single event but by three forces converging on one timeline. The origin lay in the east: after the Xiongnu-Hunnic confederation broke up in the fourth century, its western branches, pressed by the Rouran khanate, were forced to migrate west, reaching the lower Danube by way of the Caucasus and the steppe north of the Black Sea. Germanic and Alan peoples already lived there, and the three-way fighting there wore down the Huns' strength while at the same time pushing them up against the Roman frontier. On the Roman side, since the permanent division of the empire in 395 the West had retained only the residue of the tax base and the field army; since 375 large numbers of Visigoths and Vandals had entered imperial territory, crossing the Danube in 376 and being enrolled as federates by Theodosius I in 382, and the guest-settlements of the late fourth century had been the first buffer Rome placed between itself and the steppe peoples. The moment the Huns arrived, that buffer ceased to work. The Huns' own choice was decisive: they saw a weak West after Aetius fell from favour in 428, empty towns along the Danube, and an East and West that distrusted each other, so they struck the thinnest section of the frontier first, took a foothold and its supplies, and then drove deeper into western Europe on the strength of the mobility their horses gave them, rather than hurling themselves against Constantinople. The turn eastwards to extort money in 447 shows the same logic: they knew well that Rome's capacity to pay far exceeded its capacity to fight, and that diplomacy and blackmail were cheaper than war.
impact: 這場入侵的後果，遠超過匈人本身的存亡。最直接的一層是羅馬的錢與城：442年斯特拉斯堡被圍，452年阿奎萊亞、科莫、克雷莫納、米蘭與帕維亞相繼淪陷，羅馬城中的織物、金器與書籍被大批掠走，帝國的財政與信用被硬生生削去一角；東羅馬則以每年上千磅黃金的歲貢，換走了短期內君士坦丁堡的安全。第二層是制度的變化：羅馬在西線再無能力以公民步兵填線，帝國防線日益倚賴外族盟軍與客居者，這種用錢買邊境的策略最終演成西羅馬的依附式生存。匈人的推進同時把整個歐洲的部族版圖推倒重排：阿蘭人、勃艮第人、法蘭克人、汪達爾人、奧多瓦爾人被逼著接連遷徙，日耳曼人首次大規模進入萊茵河與多瑙河內陸，取代了羅馬的行政與地租。第三層是長期的族群遺產：454年格皮德人於那達奧河擊潰匈人聯盟之後，匈人諸部散入中歐與東歐，融入阿蘭、匈奴與日耳曼的混血群體，在五世紀末至六世紀的民族遷移潮中扮演要角；阿提拉的戰名雖在453年隨其死亡而消失，羅馬與草原民族的世界觀卻已徹底改變，西歐的古典秩序再無可能復原。
impactEn: The consequences of this invasion reached far beyond the survival of the Huns themselves. The most immediate layer was Roman money and Roman towns: Argentoratum was besieged in 442, and in 452 Aquileia, Como, Cremona, Milan and Pavia fell in turn, with the cloth, plate and books of the Roman cities carried off in bulk, taking a hard slice out of the empire's finances and credit; the Eastern Empire, meanwhile, bought short-term safety for Constantinople with a tribute of more than a thousand pounds of gold a year. The second layer was institutional. Rome could no longer fill its western line with its own citizen infantry, and the frontier came to rest ever more heavily on federate allies and guest settlers, so that the strategy of buying the frontier with money hardened into a dependent existence for the West. At the same time the Hunnic advance overturned the tribal map of Europe: Alans, Burgundians, Franks, Vandals and Ostrogoths were forced into one migration after another, and for the first time the Germans moved in bulk into the interior of the Rhine and Danube, taking over the administration and the rents of Rome. The third layer was a long ethnic legacy. After the Gepids broke the Hunnic confederation at the Nedao in 454, the Hunnic peoples dispersed into central and eastern Europe, absorbed into mixed Alan, Hunnic and Germanic groups, and played a major part in the migrations of the late fifth and sixth centuries. Attila's name vanished with him in 453, but the picture of the world held by Rome and by the steppe peoples had changed completely: the classical order of the West was never to be restored.
result: 打到最後，匈人沒有被逐出歐洲，羅馬也沒有收復多瑙河。451年卡塔拉尼恩平原之戰是唯一一場正面決戰，聯軍靠西哥特重騎的衝鋒與羅馬騎兵的包抄逼退匈軍，但從頭到尾沒有追上正在撤退的匈人，也沒有奪回已失去的城邑；同一戰役還留下阿提拉日蝕之類的說法，說明戰果被敵我雙方各自放大。452年匈人回師掃蕩義大利，把阿奎萊亞、米蘭、帕維亞洗劫一空，再翻越阿爾卑斯山回到多瑙河，瓦倫提尼安三世只能靠外交與賠款了事，沒有能力追擊。453年阿提拉死，聯盟內部分裂；454年格皮德王阿爾達里克在多瑙河中游的那達奧河擊潰匈人主力，聯盟崩解，魯吉爾、赫魯爾與北匈奴諸部各自西遷或北還，帝國版圖在數年內被重新分配。就戰役本身而言，羅馬的結論是殘酷的：可以用黃金買得數年光陰，可以用聯軍擋下一次正面進攻，但沒有任何辦法終止草原民族向西的壓力；匈人的結論同樣清楚：他們能在歐洲打仗、能劫掠、能勒索，卻無法在羅馬與日耳曼聯軍的全面抵抗下建立持久的統治，最後靠本族內戰才脫身，而真正的受益者，是那些在匈人洪流中學會以聯盟自保的日耳曼部族——五年後，羅馬皇帝瓦倫提尼安三世遇弒，西羅馬的皇權已是風雨飄搖。
resultEn: In the end the Huns were not driven out of Europe, and Rome did not recover the Danube. The battle of the Catalaunian Plains in 451 was the only set-piece encounter, and the alliance turned the Hunnic host back with the charge of the Visigothic heavy horse and a counterstroke by Roman cavalry, but it never caught the retreating Huns and recovered none of the lost towns; the same battle left behind stories of an eclipse of the sun over Attila, which shows the result being magnified by both sides. In 452 the Huns swept back through Italy, stripped Aquileia, Milan and Pavia, and recrossed the Alps to the Danube; Valentinian III could only settle the matter by diplomacy and indemnity, with no force left to pursue them. Attila died in 453 and the confederation split apart; in 454 Ardaric, king of the Gepids, destroyed the main Hunnic force at the Nedao in the middle Danube, the alliance collapsed, and the Rugii, Heruli and northern Hunnic peoples either migrated west or returned north, with the imperial map redistributed within a few years. The conclusion for Rome was brutal: gold could buy a few years of peace and an alliance could turn back one frontal invasion, but nothing could stop the westward pressure of the steppe peoples. The Huns' conclusion was equally plain: they could fight, plunder and extort in Europe, but they could not build a lasting rule against the combined resistance of Romans and Germans, and they escaped only through a civil war of their own kin. The real beneficiaries were the Germanic peoples, who had learned to protect themselves through alliances in the Hunnic flood: five years later the Roman emperor Valentinian III was murdered, and Western imperial authority was already crumbling.
